Chrome Cannon Glass — Codea project

Load on iPad:
1. Unzip so you have a folder named ChromeCannonGlass.codea
2. Open the Files app → On My iPad → Codea
3. Copy ChromeCannonGlass.codea into the Codea folder
4. Open Codea — the project appears on the home screen
5. Tap it → Play (landscape)

PLAY tab: drag to aim, FIRE (or Tab) to shoot, RESET to reload.
MIXER tab: Fruity Loops–style Master + all volumes. SET ALL 80% for unity.
Yell into the mic or crank Master/OUT and fire to shatter the main-screen glass.
Tweaking any mixer fader resets the screen glass.
